requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with Increased Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles supporting 6K Black and 6K CMY page yields, with bottle size for CMY >8K.
requirements.Rationale: Increased ink capacity and unique keying improve user experience and reduce frequency of replacements, supporting higher page yield.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with NOA-F and IDS systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles must be keyed, support 6K Black and 6K CMY yields, and CMY bottle must have capacity >8K. Successfully tested for fit and function in printer.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure new ink bottles and filling system achieve spill-free performance during installation and use.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces customer complaints and warranty costs, improves brand perception.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with bottle design and NOA-F system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spill incidents in 99.9% of installation cycles during qualification testing.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Implement NOA-F with a metal foiled labyrinth and a lid label. No change to click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and traceability, leverages existing mechanisms for cost and time efficiency.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on NOA-F and bottle design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F units include metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, and pass reliability and traceability tests.

requirements.Title: Reuse Superamp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Inks
requirements.Description: Reuse existing Superamp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without reformulation.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time and cost, ensures proven ink quality.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with new bottles and NOA-F.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Superamp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks function as required with new system, no reformulation needed.

requirements.Title: Reliability and Characterization Modelling
requirements.Description: Conduct reliability, WVTR, air gain, flow rate, and IDS characterization and modelling, including startup and NOA-F EOL.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures system reliability, performance, and longevity.
requirements.Dependencies: Related to IDS, NOA-F, and ink system design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All models completed and validated against test data; system meets reliability targets.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modelling
requirements.Description: Model ink stability in tank and assess impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: Prevents print quality degradation over time and ensures customer satisfaction.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on ink formulation and tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Stability model completed; PQ maintained over expected tank life.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Parts for Warranty Support
requirements.Description: Provide NOA-F as service parts to support warranty claims and repairs.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and customer support for warranty repairs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F available as service part and integrated in warranty process.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 technology on the ink bottle lid for enhanced authentication or tracking.
requirements.Rationale: Improves product authentication and anti-counterfeit measures.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on lid and bottle design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 successfully integrated and functional on production lids.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Magi Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 line for NOA-F, add Magi ink cart and labelling tool in Orcus 5, and provide mold for 1 to 4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: Enables manufacturing of new components and ensures production readiness.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on final design of NOA-F, ink cart, and caps.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SA14 line and Orcus 5 upgrades completed, new caps molded and validated in production.

requirements.Title: Support Customer-Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design system to allow customers to replace PHA and NOA-F components easily.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability, reduces downtime and service costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on mechanical and user interface design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Customers can replace PHA and NOA-F with no tools and minimal instructions; validated in user testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80k Pages
requirements.Description: Achieve new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages per device.
requirements.Rationale: Extends product life and reduces total cost of ownership for users.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on reliability of critical components (PHA, NOA-F, ink system, etc.).
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer passes 80,000 page yield test with no critical failures during warranty period.

requirements.Title: Support for Hi + Hi PDL SKU (SKU 2) PaaS
requirements.Description: Develop and support a SKU for Hi + Hi PDL with Platform as a Service (PaaS) business model.
requirements.Rationale: Targets business customers and enables flexible service offerings.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, Business Development, SMB/Enterprise Customers
requirements.Dependencies: Requires alignment with business model and service infrastructure.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SKU 2 available for order with PaaS support, integrated with business systems.

requirements.Title: Increase Tank Size for Reddington ID
requirements.Description: Increase tank size for Reddington ID product variant, with no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher ink capacity and extended printing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tank size increased and validated in Reddington ID variant, ADF remains unchanged.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Implement EPS foam packaging for improved product protection during shipping.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces shipping damage, improves customer satisfaction.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: EPS foam packaging implemented and passes drop/shipping tests.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel requirements for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Enables sales in regulated markets and supports sustainability goals.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on product design and documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel for PDL SKU.

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to accommodate tank protrusion and optimize size.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical compatibility and minimizes device footprint.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays modified and validated for tank fit and function.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3” CGD (Color Graphic Display) into the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user interface and accessibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD display installed and passes usability and functional tests.

requirements.Title: Platform with 4 Tubes and New Routing
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes, implement new tube routing and integration for 4-tube platform.
requirements.Rationale: Supports new ink delivery architecture for improved reliability and performance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4-tube platform integrated, new routing validated for flow and reliability.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station aerosol management with spit platform changes due to new tank design.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents contamination and ensures clean operation with larger tanks.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on tank and service station design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol management system updated and validated for new configuration.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force model to account for new tube routing and weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable motion and print quality with new mechanical configuration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage model updated, system passes reliability and PQ tests.

requirements.Title: Paper Path to Support Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign paper path to support increased page life (80k pages).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical durability and reliability over product lifespan.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path passes 80k page durability test.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part (Post 80k Life)
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance as a serviceable part to be replaced post 80k page life at Service Center.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and extends product usable life.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part can be replaced at service center after 80k pages.

requirements.Title: 140ml K Bottles and New CMY Bottle Sizes
requirements.Description: Introduce 140ml Black (K) bottles and new XX ml CMY bottles for the system.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher yield and aligns with system requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 140ml K and new CMY bottles available and validated for use.

requirements.Title: New IDS Make-Break and FI Connection
requirements.Description: Implement new IDS make-break and FI connection, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI One SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability, traceability, and system integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New IDS and FI connection integrated and validated in system tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new IDS startup algorithm and air management system for improved reliability.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent startup and operation, prevents air-related failures.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup algorithm and air management pass reliability tests and meet startup KPIs.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Define new print quality goals and depletion metrics to align with page yield definition.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent print quality and accurate yield reporting.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print quality and depletion metrics defined, implemented, and validated.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU in the new system.
requirements.Rationale: Leverages proven components to reduce cost and risk.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Components reused and validated in system integration tests.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module into the printer for wireless connectivity.
requirements.Rationale: Enables modern wireless features for end users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Stingray Wi-Fi module functional and passes connectivity tests.

requirements.Title: Dune Firmware Platform
requirements.Description: Utilize Dune firmware platform for the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistency and reuse of proven firmware platform.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Dune firmware operational and passes system validation tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features in both hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances device security and compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Gauss4.xx security features functional and pass security validation tests.

requirements.Title: High Throughput (25/20 ppm)
requirements.Description: Printer must support throughput of 25/20 pages per minute (PDL: 25/19 ppm).
requirements.Rationale: Meets competitive benchmarks and customer expectations for speed.
requirements.Dependencies: Mechanical, firmware, and ink system design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm) in performance tests.

requirements.Title: Serviceability - Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design maintenance box to be customer replaceable for improved serviceability.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs, increases user satisfaction.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Customers can replace maintenance box without tools; validated in user tests.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate SMB manageability and solution support (e.g., WJA, HPSM, JAM).
requirements.Rationale: Addresses needs of SMB customers for device management and integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB solutions functional and validated in SMB customer environment.

requirements.Title: PaaS Support for Schedule
requirements.Description: Ensure PaaS (Platform as a Service) is supported according to schedule.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with business goals for flexible service offerings.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS offering live and available by scheduled launch date.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K Flexibility
requirements.Description: Allow flexibility to host 12K-CMYK and trade page 6K as needed.
requirements.Rationale: Enables support for different customer needs and market segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System can be configured for 12K-CMYK and 6K trade page options.
